description: Performance sweep - Node.js: valkey-glide-node vs ioredis (high-throughput configs). There is no bench-aws.sh version flag for this client: bump @valkey/valkey-glide in node/package.json and node/package-lock.json on a pushed ref and pass --repo-tag. ioredis is the stable yardstick, so compare GLIDE/ioredis ratios across runs to cancel instance-to-instance noise. Connections and iterations match perf-ruby.
